items.headline: Chris Jordan saw it through late on. Calm as a cucumber.
items.summary: James Vince stroked 60 from 38 and Chris Jordan produced a late cameo with the bat as Southern Brave finally got their campaign up and running with victory under the lights at the Ageas Bowl.

items.headline: James Vince fires Southern Brave to first win despite Adam Milne heroics
items.summary: Liam Livingstone produced his first significant contribution of the Hundred with an unbeaten half-century as the Brave chased down a testing total.

items.headline: Women's Hundred 2021 — Edwards, Dunkley and the Vipers connection
items.summary: Three players who came through the same regional side now anchor the batting order, and their coach is not surprised by any of it.

items.headline: Tom Helm blinks first as the Brave hold their nerve
items.summary: Adam Milne's 3 for 15 had seemingly set up Birmingham Phoenix for a narrow victory, right up until the final set of five.

items.headline: Over 400 players available in The Hundred auction
items.summary: The longlist has been revealed, with Joe Root, Davina Perrin, Nadine de Klerk and Shaheen Shah Afridi all set to go under the hammer.

items.headline: Ageas Bowl to host a double-header in the closing week
items.summary: Both squads will play back to back on the south coast, with tickets released to members first on Friday morning.
